description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You leave the top layer of yourself behind, still steaming, still roughly your shape.

Attempt a single Acrobatics check with a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape every grabbed, restrained and immobilized condition affecting you at once. On any success you also Step, leaving the shed layer behind you in your old space.

cinderfall.incomplete: Resolving one Acrobatics check against several simultaneous conditions at once, plus the resulting free Step on success, has no rule-element hook -- the +2 circumstance bonus in isolation would be trivially buildable, but the card's actual mechanic is the compressed-check structure, not the bonus alone.
